transport_method_source.description: FFT-derived species self and distinct correlation functions, independently fitted slopes, and Onsager tensor serialization.

tensor_contract.qualification_policy: Report non-PSD total tensors as estimates that fail admissibility; do not silently project, clip, repair or use them as qualified physical transport.

interpretation.non_psd_policy: Finite-trajectory correlation curves are fit independently; a non-PSD estimated Onsager tensor is retained as source evidence and flagged. It is not proof that the underlying material transport is nonphysical.
interpretation.uncertainty_policy: The bundled ReactCA transport JSON omits py-OATS fit dictionaries / covariance. Missing uncertainty must remain explicit; do not infer it from decimal precision.
interpretation.missing_data_policy: Exact formula and temperature matching is required by default. Nearest-temperature and identity-scaled missing-formula fallback are not treated as measured transport.
interpretation.claim_ceiling: Pinned source data and tensor-consistency audit only. No new diffusion coefficients, experimentally validated model reproduction, phase prediction or material discovery is established.
